newsitem.title: CANADA: Baton, Electrohome to merge TV units.
newsitem.headline: Baton, Electrohome to merge TV units.

text.p: Baton Broadcasting Inc said that it will merge its broadcasting assets with Electrohome Ltd and give Electrohome 8.3 million Baton common shares and cash.
Electrohome will receive C$35 million less the cost of acquiring one million Baton common shares, Baton said.

The two companies have jointly owned strategic alliances to develop television chains in Western Canada and Southwestern Ontario. The alliances were approved by the CRTC in June and will be completed, Baton said.

The new Baton board will have 13 members including two nominees from Electrohome, as long as Electrohome holds at least 80 percent of the Baton shares acquired under the deal and at least 10 percent of outstanding Baton common shares.
After the deal closes, Baton will control 24 television stations in Ontario, Saskatchewan and Alberta, up from 22.

To fulfil the requirements of the deal, Baton must acquire one million of its common shares under a normal course issuer bid for up to 1.4 million shares through the Toronto and Montreal Stock Exchanges.
Baton, which already owns 28.6 percent in CTV, posted 1995 revenues of C$254.2 million.
Electrohome had 1995 revenues of C$186.4 million.
